privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta.description: Privacy Policy of Qualisoft Co., Ltd. — Purpose of processing personal information, retention period, third-party provision, rights of data subjects, destruction, safety measures, and Chief Privacy Officer.
privacy.head.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Qualisoft Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the “Company”) establishes and discloses the following Privacy Policy in accordance with Article 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act of the Republic of Korea to protect the personal information of data subjects (customers) and to handle related grievances promptly and smoothly.
privacy.s1.title: Purpose of Processing Personal Information
privacy.s1.body: The Company processes personal information for the following purposes and does not use it for any purpose other than those listed below.
privacy.s1.item1: Confirming customer intent to register, identifying and authenticating customers for service provision, maintaining and managing membership status, settling payments for the supply of goods or services, and supplying or delivering goods or services, etc.
privacy.s2.title: Processing and Retention Period of Personal Information
privacy.s2.p1: ① The Company processes and retains personal information within the retention and use period consented to by the data subject at the time of collection, or within the retention and use period prescribed by applicable laws and regulations.
privacy.s2.p2: ② Specific processing and retention periods for personal information are as follows:
privacy.s2.item1: Customer registration and management: Until termination of the service agreement or cancellation of membership; provided, however, that if any claims or obligations remain, until the settlement of such claims or obligations
privacy.s2.item2: Records on contracts, withdrawal of subscription, payment, and supply of goods in e-commerce: 5 years
privacy.s3.title: Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
privacy.s3.body: The Company does not provide personal information to third parties except in cases falling under Article 17 of the Personal Information Protection Act, such as where separate consent is obtained from the data subject or where special provisions exist in laws.
privacy.s4.title: Rights and Obligations of Data Subjects and Legal Representatives, and How to Exercise Them
privacy.s4.body: Data subjects may exercise the following personal information protection rights against the Company at any time:
privacy.s4.item2: Request for correction in case of errors
privacy.s5.title: Items of Personal Information Processed
privacy.s5.body: The Company processes the following items of personal information:
privacy.s5.item1: Name, date of birth, address, telephone number, mobile phone number, gender, email address, and payment information such as credit card numbers and bank account numbers
privacy.s6.title: Destruction of Personal Information
privacy.s6.p1: ① When personal information becomes unnecessary, such as upon the expiration of the retention period or the achievement of the processing purpose, the Company destroys the relevant personal information without delay.
privacy.s6.p2: ② The Company destroys personal information using the following methods:
privacy.s6.item1: Electronic files: Deletion of files and formatting of storage media such as disks
privacy.s7.title: Measures to Ensure the Safety of Personal Information
privacy.s7.body: The Company takes the following measures to ensure the safety of personal information:
privacy.s7.item1: Administrative measures: Establishment and implementation of an internal management plan, regular training for employees and staff
privacy.s7.item2: Technical measures: Management of access rights such as setting passwords for personal information processing systems (or computers storing personal information), installation of security programs such as antivirus software, and encryption of files storing personal information
privacy.s7.item3: Physical measures: Locking and access control of places where personal information is stored and kept
privacy.s8.title: Installation, Operation, and Rejection of Automatic Personal Information Collection Devices
privacy.s8.p1: ① The Company uses “cookies,” which store and frequently retrieve usage information to provide individualized and customized services to users.
privacy.s8.p2: ② Cookies are small pieces of information sent by the server (HTTP) used to operate the website to the user’s computer browser and may also be stored on the hard disk of the user’s PC.
privacy.s8.item1: a. Purpose of using cookies: Used to provide optimized information to users by identifying visit and usage patterns, popular search terms, and secure connection status across the services and websites visited by the user.
privacy.s8.item2: b. Installation, operation, and rejection of cookies: You can refuse to store cookies through the option settings in the Tools > Internet Options > Privacy menu at the top of your web browser.
privacy.s8.item3: c. If you refuse to store cookies, you may experience difficulties in using customized services.
privacy.s8.ga.title: d. Visitor statistics (Google Analytics)
privacy.s8.ga.intro: We use Google Analytics to understand how our site is used so we can improve it. It only runs if you choose “Accept” in the cookie notice, and we do not send information that identifies you, such as your name or contact details. Google processes these statistics on our behalf, so the information below is transferred outside Korea.
privacy.s8.ga.when: To the United States and other countries where Google operates servers, each time you view a page after accepting cookies, over an encrypted connection (HTTPS)
privacy.s8.ga.items: Cookie identifiers, pages viewed and time spent, browser and device type, approximate region (estimated from your IP address, which is not stored), and how you reached the site
privacy.s8.ga.purpose: Visitor statistics and site improvement — not used for advertising
privacy.s8.ga.keep: Individual visit records are deleted automatically after 2 months, and visitor-level information 14 months after your last visit
privacy.s8.ga.refuse: You can withdraw your consent at any time by choosing “Reject” in the cookie notice or using “Open cookie settings” below. Opting out does not limit your use of the site
privacy.s8.ga.abroad: If you visit from the European Union, Japan, China or elsewhere, information is transferred only after you give prior consent in the same way. Our legal basis is your consent, and Google maintains appropriate safeguards, including certification under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses.
privacy.s9.title: Chief Privacy Officer
privacy.s9.body: The Company has designated a Chief Privacy Officer as follows to take overall responsibility for personal information processing and to handle complaints and relief for damages of data subjects related to personal information processing.
privacy.s9.sub: ▶ Chief Privacy Officer (Business Owner or Representative)
privacy.s10.title: Changes to the Privacy Policy
privacy.s10.body: This Privacy Policy is effective from November 24, 2026. (Previous version: effective November 12, 2026; earlier version: effective January 23, 2019.)
privacy.s11.title: Personal data processed by the Meta app "Qualisoft Social Publishing"
privacy.s11.intro: Qualisoft operates the Meta app "Qualisoft Social Publishing" (App ID 1822043052409589) to publish content created by the company (card news and reels) to its Facebook Page "{page}" and its Instagram account @qualisoft_official. Only company staff who hold a role on the app use it. The app has no feature that lets members of the public log in or submit information.
privacy.s11.a.title: A. Data we process and why
privacy.s11.a.r1_data: Access tokens granted to the app by the publishing staff member (company Page token, Instagram publishing token)
privacy.s11.a.r1_purpose: Publishing to the company Page and account, and checking the result
privacy.s11.a.r1_source: Granted by the staff member through Meta's login dialog
privacy.s11.a.r2_data: ID and name of the company Page and Instagram account
privacy.s11.a.r2_purpose: Confirming that the publishing target is the company's own account
privacy.s11.a.r3_data: ID, caption, link, publishing status, and copyright-check result of posts the company published; Instagram publishing quota
privacy.s11.a.r3_purpose: Confirming publication, preventing duplicate posts, keeping a publishing record
privacy.s11.a.r4_data: Deletion requester's email address, name (or display name), related account name, identity-check message, and the outcome
privacy.s11.a.r4_purpose: Handling the deletion request, notifying the outcome, and keeping a record that it was handled
privacy.s11.a.r4_source: Sent directly by the requester by email or message
privacy.s11.a.note: The Facebook user token used while granting permissions is used only to obtain the company Page token and is not stored.
privacy.s11.b.title: B. Data we do not process
privacy.s11.b.body: The app does not retrieve information about Page visitors, followers, commenters, or people who send messages, nor advertising or Insights data. If this scope changes, we will update this policy first.
privacy.s11.c.title: C. Storage and protection
privacy.s11.c.items: Access tokens are kept only in Windows Credential Manager (the operating system's encrypted store) on the publishing staff member's work PC. They are never copied into files, documents, or messengers.
Publishing records (post IDs and links) are kept in a working folder on the publishing staff member's work PC.
We do not store this data on a separate server and do not provide it to third parties.
privacy.s11.d.title: D. Retention
privacy.s11.d.items: Access tokens: deleted immediately when replaced with a new token, or when the staff member revokes the app's permission or leaves the publishing role. The Facebook Page token is replaced before Meta's data access period (about 90 days) ends.
Publishing records: kept while the post is public, and destroyed 1 year after the post is taken down.
Deletion request records: kept for 1 year from the date we notify you of the outcome, then destroyed.
privacy.s11.e.title: E. Relationship with Meta
privacy.s11.e.p1: The app sends company-created content and captions to Meta. The company does not newly provide personal data to Meta in this process.
privacy.s11.e.p2: Staff login and permission grants are processed by Meta under the Meta Privacy Policy.
privacy.s11.f.title: F. Meta app data deletion requests
privacy.s11.f.s1: 1. Remove the app yourself (takes effect immediately)
privacy.s11.f.s1_items: Facebook: Settings & privacy → Settings → Apps and websites → remove "Qualisoft Social Publishing".
Instagram: Settings → Website permissions → Apps and websites → remove.
After removal, the app can no longer access your account. To have the company delete data it keeps, please also send a request under 2.
privacy.s11.f.s2: 2. Ask the company to delete your data
privacy.s11.f.s2_channel: Channel: the email address of the Chief Privacy Officer in Section 9. Please use the subject "[Meta App Data Deletion Request]".
privacy.s11.f.s2_min_items: Your name or Facebook/Instagram display name
The related account (Facebook profile/Page name or Instagram username)
The data you want deleted (access tokens, publishing records, etc.; "all" if unsure)
privacy.s11.f.s2_warn: Do not send passwords, access tokens, or copies of ID documents. We never ask for them.
privacy.s11.f.s3_body: We will reply to the email address you used. To confirm that the account is yours, we will ask you to send the confirmation number from our reply as a message from that Facebook/Instagram account to the company Page or account. This step may be skipped for requests from verified company staff.
privacy.s11.f.s4_items: We will notify you of the outcome by email within 10 days of receiving your request, including the deleted items, the date and time of deletion, and a request number. If the identity check is not completed within that period, we will tell you within the same period why the data could not yet be deleted and what confirmation is needed.

If any data must be retained by law and cannot be deleted, we will tell you the reason, the retention period, and how to object. You may raise an objection with the Chief Privacy Officer in Section 9.
